blocks.html: Data for updating one or more gift cards.

types.name: UpdateGiftCardsWorkflowInput
types.description: Data for updating one or more gift cards.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the gift card to update.

children.name: value
children.description: The updated monetary value of the gift card.

children.name: status
children.description: The updated status of the gift card.

children.name: note
children.description: An updated note about the gift card.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The updated three-letter ISO currency code.

children.name: expires_at
children.description: The updated expiration date, or null to remove the expiration.

children.name: customer_id
children.description: The updated ID of the customer associated with the gift card.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Updated custom key-value pairs attached to the gift card.
